_nequa est natio illorum_ (Weber/Gryson); _nequam est natio eorum_ (Clementina) – worthless is their generation. The classical _nequam_ is an ideclinable adjective; in vulgar Latin, it takes the declinable form _nequs_.– Literature:
1883. Philipp Thielmann: _Beiträge zur Textkritik der Vulgata, insbes. des Buches Judith. Beigabe zum Jahresbericht 1882/83 der Königlichen Studienanstalt Speier_. Speyer (64 pp.), pp. 9–10.
1996. Scarpat II, p. 543.
_oportet justum esse et humanum_ – the just must also be humane. – P.W. Skehan: Notes on the Latin Text of the Book of Wisdom. _Catholic Biblical Quarterly_ 4.3 (1942) 230–243, at p. 238.
